rule_descriptions.F_HOST_RECEIPT_GATE: Four required F-host recovery/output receipts must exist before final-ready or business-row promotion.
rule_descriptions.SINGLE_RUNNER_GATE: No second runner/task/takeover while canonical recovery is unresolved.
rule_descriptions.SOURCE_SEQUENCE_GATE: Source candidate IDs remain contiguous and unique.
rule_descriptions.OPERATION_SEQUENCE_GATE: Operation IDs remain contiguous and unique.
rule_descriptions.EXAMPLE_SEQUENCE_GATE: Prepared example IDs remain unique and prior repairs are preserved.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_RELEASE_DATE_GATE: Use the current HMLR INSPIRE release date; stale local files must not silently outrank the current release.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_MONTHLY_REFRESH_GATE: INSPIRE release freshness is checked against the first-Sunday monthly publication policy.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_OGL_GATE: HMLR INSPIRE reuse remains subject to the Open Government Licence.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_INDICATIVE_EXTENT_GATE: INSPIRE polygons are indicative extent/position and must not be promoted to exact legal boundaries.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_INSPIRE_ID_GATE: Exact Land Registry-INSPIRE ID is retained for spatial matching and provenance.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_TITLE_PLAN_GATE: Exact title extent claims require the title plan rather than INSPIRE alone.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_FREEHOLD_SCOPE_GATE: INSPIRE freehold subset limitations are retained; absence is not converted to unregistered certainty.
rule_descriptions.OS_T50_SECONDARY_GATE: OS Terrain 50 remains a secondary terrain cross-check, not the primary 1m source.
rule_descriptions.OS_T50_50M_POST_GATE: 50m post spacing is retained explicitly and never interpreted as 1m detail.
rule_descriptions.OS_T50_10M_CONTOUR_GATE: 10m contour interval is portrayal/model structure, not parcel min/max accuracy.
rule_descriptions.OS_T50_ANNUAL_JULY_GATE: Terrain 50 annual July update cadence is provenance freshness, not parcel acquisition time.
rule_descriptions.OS_T50_TIN_GATE: Terrain 50 source TIN is distinguished from distributed grid/contour products.
rule_descriptions.OS_T50_INTERPOLATION_GATE: Grid/contour output interpolated from the TIN is treated as derived.
rule_descriptions.OS_T50_DATUM_GATE: Terrain 50 heights use applicable OS datum, normally ODN; datum identity remains explicit.
rule_descriptions.OS_T50_BARE_EARTH_GATE: Buildings and vegetation are removed from the Terrain 50 bare-earth model.
rule_descriptions.OS_T50_RMSE_SCOPE_GATE: OS Terrain 50 accuracy requirements are not substituted for EA LiDAR RMSE.
rule_descriptions.OSGM15_GB_STDERR_GATE: OSGM15 Great Britain 0.008m standard error is retained only as transformation/geoid-model evidence.
rule_descriptions.OSTN15_NETWORK_GATE: OSTN15 old-network 0.1m RMS agreement is horizontal transformation evidence, not terrain vertical accuracy.
rule_descriptions.OSNET_STATION_GATE: OS Net station coordinate errors are control-network evidence, not parcel DTM error.
rule_descriptions.OSGM15_GNSS_EXCLUSION_GATE: OSGM15 stated standard error excludes GNSS heighting error and cannot stand alone as end-to-end uncertainty.
rule_descriptions.TRANSFORM_NOT_DTM_GATE: Transformation accuracy must not be conflated with source DTM accuracy.
rule_descriptions.EA_DTM1M_PRIMARY_GATE: Environment Agency 1m DTM remains the primary parcel-scale elevation source.
rule_descriptions.EA_DTM1M_RMSE_GATE: EA +/-15cm RMSE is dataset/survey vertical accuracy evidence and is not converted into a deterministic parcel error bound.
rule_descriptions.EA_DTM1M_CRS_GATE: EA DTM1m native CRS EPSG:27700 remains explicit.
rule_descriptions.EA_COMPOSITE_PERIOD_GATE: Composite survey period/freshness is distinct from the exact contributing survey for a target parcel.
rule_descriptions.EA_METADATA_INDEX_REQUIRED: Contributing-survey identity stays UNKNOWN until the EA metadata-index feature match succeeds.
rule_descriptions.EA_GPKG_SPATIOTEMPORAL_GATE: GeoPackage metadata index spatial/temporal extent is discovery lineage, not elevation.
rule_descriptions.EA_SURVEY_ID_MATCH: Survey/block/phase identity must come from metadata attributes, not filename inference.
rule_descriptions.EA_SPATIAL_MATCH: Metadata survey footprint must spatially cover the target parcel/point.
rule_descriptions.EA_TEMPORAL_MATCH: Matched survey acquisition time must be retained separately from dataset publication date.
rule_descriptions.EA_RESOLUTION_MATCH: Matched source resolution must be retained and not inferred from composite output resolution.
rule_descriptions.EA_TRANSFORM_MATCH: Survey transform/geoid lineage must be retained where available.
rule_descriptions.OGC_BBOX_CRS_GATE: bbox-crs is explicit when query coordinates are not default CRS84.
rule_descriptions.OGC_QUERYABLES_GATE: Queryable names/types are discovered before attribute filters are issued.
rule_descriptions.OGC_CQL2_GATE: CQL2 spatial/temporal predicates are query semantics, not source-authority evidence.
rule_descriptions.OGC_RECORDS_GATE: Catalogue record matching is discovery evidence and not the contributing-survey feature match.
rule_descriptions.JSONFG_REPRESENTATION_GATE: JSON-FG CRS/time encoding preserves representation semantics but does not increase terrain accuracy.
rule_descriptions.NO_DATA_NOT_ZERO: Unknown, missing or unmatched values remain unknown; they are never converted to zero.
rule_descriptions.NUMERIC_PRESERVATION: Existing measured 1m/2m values are unchanged by QA-only increments.
rule_descriptions.RESULT_CONFIDENCE_ROLE: 96% is repository workflow confidence and not universal statistical coverage.
rule_descriptions.BUSINESS_ROW_GUARD: Business rows remain zero until canonical recovery acceptance.
rule_descriptions.FINAL_READY_GUARD: final_ready remains false while any required F-host receipt is missing.
rule_descriptions.WEB_OVERLAY_ROLE: The increment overlay exposes QA rows line by line but is not live browser acceptance on port 8012.
rule_descriptions.MAIN_MANIFEST_CONCURRENCY: Shared main manifest is not rewritten by this increment.
